pr_title: fix(wasm): support inlined WASM in Node < v16 (fix #8620)
pr_body:
Node < v16 do not provide a global `atob()` function for decoding base64 strings, and must use `Buffer.from()` instead. Furthermore, `Buffer.from(str, 'base64').toString()` is much faster than `atob()` in Node. Thus, prefer to use `Buffer.from()` if possible.

<!-- Thank you for contributing! -->

### Description

This fixes #8620 for Vite 3. The bug is caused because Vite generates code that uses [`atob()`](https://nodejs.org/api/globals.html#atobdata), which is available only on Node.js 16+. This PR solves this by:

- Use [`Buffer.from()`](https://nodejs.org/api/buffer.html#static-method-bufferfromstring-encoding) if it exists. This is _faster_ than `atob()` (see below), so the code prioritizes it.
- Check for existence of `atob()` before using it.
- If neither options are available, throw an Error.

Note that `Buffer.from()` is much faster than `atob()`:

```console
// Node v16.15.1

> var bigStr = btoa('1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.repeat(100000));
> console.time('atob'); atob(bigStr); console.timeEnd('atob');
atob: 117.196ms
> console.time('Buffer.from'); Buffer.from(bigStr, 'base64').toString(); console.timeEnd('Buffer.from');
Buffer.from: 9.797ms
```

This is because `atob()` is [intentionally unoptimized](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/6975dd14253e936509e2a68b293101fa234e53af/lib/buffer.js#L1259-L1261). (See [rationale](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/38433#issuecomment-828426932))

### Additional context

<!-- e.g. is there anything you'd like reviewers to focus on? -->

[vite-plugin-wasm](https://github.com/Menci/vite-plugin-wasm) has the same bug (see https://github.com/Menci/vite-plugin-wasm/pull/3).

issue_context.title: Library bundle with inlined WASM fails in Node < 16
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

A library (built with `build.lib`) with inlined WebAssembly (`.wasm`) files fails in Node.js < 16. This is because the Vite-generated bindings use [`atob()`](https://nodejs.org/api/globals.html#atobdata), which is available only in Node.js 16+.

The binding code is:
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/d402ad3ae2b724fde7702eb255af502db7ca94d4/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/wasm.ts#L9-L18

Although Vite is primarily geared towards web browsers, Vite's Library Mode is useful for developing isomorphic libraries that must support browsers and Node.js. Since Node.js v14 has plenty of time to reach EOL (due April 2023), it would be great to support it.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/pastelmind/vite-wasm-node14-bug

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 12.4
    CPU: (8) x64 Apple M1
    Memory: 147.27 MB / 16.00 GB
    Shell: 5.8.1 - /bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 14.19.3 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.19.3/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.19 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.19.3/bin/yarn
    npm: 8.12.1 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.19.3/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 102.0.5005.115
    Firefox: 101.0
    Safari: 15.5
  npmPackages:
    vite: ^2.9.12 => 2.9.12
```


### Used Package Manager
